content.title: Google Built-In: A Smarter Way to Drive with General Motors Vehicles
content.text: General Motors (GM) and Google have partnered to bring Google Built-In to a growing number of GM vehicles. Google Built-In is a suite of features and apps that are deeply integrated into the vehicle’s infotainment system, giving drivers and passengers a more hands-free, connected, and personalized driving experience. What is Google Built-In? Google Built-In includes a variety of features and apps, including: Google Maps: Get real-time traffic updates, turn-by-turn navigation, and estimated arrival times. Google Assistant: Use your voice to control the vehicle’s infotainment system, make phone calls, send text messages, play music, and more. Google Play: Access a wide range of apps, including music, podcasts, audiobooks, and games. Google Voice Search: Use your voice to search for information online, find places of interest, and get answers to your questions. How to use Google Built-In To use Google Built-In, simply say “Hey Google” followed by your request. For example, you can say “Hey Google, navigate to the nearest Starbucks” or “Hey Google, play my favorite playlist.” You can also use the touchscreen display on the vehicle’s infotainment system to interact with Google Built-In. Benefits of using Google Built-In Google Built-In offers a number of benefits, including: Convenience: Google Built-In features are hands-free, so you can keep your eyes on the road and your hands on the wheel. Personalization: Google Built-In learns your preferences over time and provides personalized recommendations. Connectivity: Google Built-In keeps you connected to the world around you, so you can access information and entertainment on the go. How to get Google Built-In Google Built-In is available on a growing number of GM vehicles, including: GMC: HUMMER EV Pickup, Yukon, Yukon XL, Sierra 1500 Chevrolet: Blazer EV, Bolt EV, Bolt EUV, Camaro, Colorado, Corvette Stingray, Equinox, Silverado 1500, Tahoe, Trailblazer Cadillac: CT4-V, CT5, CT5-V, Escalade, Lyriq If you are interested in getting a GM vehicle with Google Built-In, visit the GM website to learn more and find a dealer near you. Here are some specific examples of how you can use Google Built-In in your GM vehicle: Plan your trip: Use Google Maps to get real-time traffic updates, turn-by-turn navigation, and estimated arrival times. You can also use Google Maps to find places of interest, such as restaurants, gas stations, and hotels. Stay connected: Use Google Assistant to make phone calls, send text messages, and play music without taking your hands off the wheel. You can also use Google Assistant to get answers to your questions, such as “What’s the weather going to be like today?” or “What’s the score of the game?” Stay entertained: With Google Play, you can access a wide range of apps, including music, podcasts, audiobooks, and games. You can also download movies and TV shows to watch offline. Control your smart home: If you have smart home devices, you can use Google Assistant to control them from your vehicle. For example, you can say “Hey Google, turn on the lights at home” or “Hey Google, set the thermostat to 72 degrees.” Google Built-In is a powerful tool that can make your driving experience more convenient, personalized, and connected. If you are considering buying a new GM vehicle, be sure to look for one with Google Built-In. Here are some additional tips for using Google Built-In: Use voice commands whenever possible. This is the easiest and safest way to interact with Google Built-In. Personalize your settings. You can adjust the settings for Google Assistant, Google Maps, and other Google Built-In features to meet your needs. Explore the Google Play Store. There are a wide variety of apps available for Google Play, including many that are specifically designed for use in vehicles. Update your software regularly. GM and Google regularly release software updates for Google Built-In. These updates include new features, bug fixes, and security improvements. With Google Built-In, your GM vehicle is more than just a way to get from point A to point B. It’s a connected hub that can help you stay informed, entertained, and productive on the go.
